summary: Big news is Collector Crypt launching its own mobile app (Android first) right before Breakpoint. A recap post says Coinbase help pages confirm Coinbase Collect uses Collector Crypt for custody and fulfillment, so the same card supply now sits behind Coinbase, Jupiter, MoonPay and us. Fake PSA slabs are the hot pain point today, and Costco Pokémon drops sold out in minutes again. Solflare Packs got a few small organic mentions, all neutral to positive.

top_posts.text:
We're proud to announce the launch of the Collector Crypt mobile app, arriving just in time for Solana Breakpoint 2026.

Starting today, Android users are getting exclusive first access to the Collector Crypt experience through the Google Play Store.

A new chapter in https://t.co/UvfhBXAEEm
top_posts.why_it_matters: Our card partner now has its own app. More direct competition for the same buyers, and more awareness of the Collector Crypt vault model.

top_posts.text:
A digital card platform can offer fair odds and still give users poor value.

The more I research onchain TCG platforms, the more I focus on four things: inventory, randomness, pricing, and physical delivery.

Collector Crypt CEO Tuomas Holmberg’s breakdown helped clarify this. https://t.co/e3Xj5zscoQ
top_posts.why_it_matters: Crypto TCG researcher (20k followers) says fair odds aren't enough: inventory, randomness, pricing and delivery matter. Good checklist for how we explain Packs.

sources_note: X search via the x connector (searchPostsAll), posts from 2026-11-13 09:05 UTC to 2026-11-14 09:00 UTC, 14 searches. Engagement numbers are as returned by the X API at scan time. The Coinbase Collect / Collector Crypt link is a third-party recap citing Coinbase help pages, not checked by us. The Costco 'sold out in minutes' idea cites other accounts and odds language, so it's flagged for legal. Skipped: giveaway posts (QuantumSnek, Neon_RH), referral and pump posts (CrownCards '$84k from $2.50' claim), Cronos news roundups, unrelated 'top shot' sports posts. Creators already in collector-base.csv or earlier daily files (e.g. McQuaza_, knoyhead, 0x_trophy) were excluded.
